candidates.claim: The fw-01 HTTP management server is enabled and mgmt_access http is permitted from 0.0.0.0/0 on the outside interface, so firewall management is reachable from any source outside MGMT.
candidates.remediation: Remove the outside http mgmt_access entry and limit HTTP/ASDM management to the mgmt interface from 10.10.99.0/24.

candidates.claim: The baseline comparison shows an added global http 0.0.0.0 management entry on fw-01 that is not in the approved baseline.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added http 0.0.0.0 entry against the approved baseline and remove it unless an approved change record covers it.
